rationale: Independent reading: held EO 10610 (20 FR 3179) Parts I-III transfer FOA functions to State/ICA (Part I), certain military-assistance functions to Defense (Part II), and general provisions (Part III); no own term. Held EO 10893 (25 FR 10731) sec. 305(a): 'The following-described orders, and parts of orders, are hereby superseded: ... (2) Executive Order No. 10610 of May 9, 1955 (20 F.R. 3179).' That is a whole-order supersession by number, date and FR cite; sec. 306 saves actions taken, not the order; sec. 301's continuation of ICA offices is EO 10893's own text. Refutation attempts: the ACT:EO:10610>EO:10893 slice quotes a sec. 301 passage, so the producer rightly cites ACTOR_TEXT:EO:10893 and the sec. 305(a)(2) wording, which I verified in the held file. Flag PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED: EO 10822 sec. 2 revokes only Part II (verified), leaving Parts I and III to EO 10893. D6: EO 10625/10663/10742 amend sections, EO 10700 sec. 6 supersedes only the OCB proviso; EO 10973 sec. 605(a) and EO 12163 later supersede/revoke EO 10893 without naming or restoring EO 10610 (verified). No later event ignored. NO upheld. D6 answer: no later event ignored; earlier partial ends (10700 sec. 6 proviso, 10822 sec. 2 Part II) correctly treated as partial.
